# @hyeonse/design-system

Installed package version: 0.4.8

## Setup

- Import @hyeonse/design-system/tokens.css before @hyeonse/design-system/components.css, once each.
- Run preferenceScript or createPreferenceScript(...) in the document head before CSS paints; match storageKey and defaults with PreferencesProvider.
- Import utilities from /preferences, display settings from /react, existing primitives from /primitives, expanded forms from /fields, menus and dialogs from /overlays, navigation/feedback from /display, and size scopes and layouts from /layout. Do not import internal src/ or dist/ paths.
- Interactive React components require React and React DOM 19. The package uses Base UI 1.9.0 for accessible interaction foundations.
- Provide DM Sans and Noto Sans KR font assets in the consuming app if those faces are needed; the package only declares a font stack.

## Provided

- Role tokens in tokens.css and styles for display settings, forms, overlays, navigation, layout, and feedback in components.css.
- Preference validation, first-paint script, provider, hook, and display-setting controls.
- Button, TextField, Checkbox, and Badge React components with native element attributes and refs.
- Reusable input and selection controls, menus, dialogs, tooltips, toast notifications, navigation, tables, cards, and feedback components.

## Not provided

- An application router, server data fetching, rich-text editor, chart engine, or virtualized data grid.
- Font files for consuming applications; provide fonts with the required character coverage separately.
- A design-token interchange format such as DTCG.

Generated from the package declarations, CSS and authored usage metadata. Do not edit this output. Props summaries contain locally declared props; module declarations preserve inherited native attributes and refs.

# API

## preferencesKey

Default localStorage key: hyeonse-site-preferences.

Kind: utility · Import: `@hyeonse/design-system/preferences`

```typescript
export declare const preferencesKey = "hyeonse-site-preferences";
```

### Usage

- Pass the same key to createPreferenceScript and PreferencesProvider when overriding it.

Examples: `hds example display-settings`

## defaultPreferences

Default choices: system theme, cobalt accent, comfortable density, crisp corners, full motion.

Kind: utility · Import: `@hyeonse/design-system/preferences`

```typescript
export declare const defaultPreferences: Preferences;
```

### Usage

- Use as the baseline when no valid stored choice or site default exists.

### States

- system
- cobalt
- comfortable
- crisp
- full

### Limits

- This constant does not include site-specific defaults.

Examples: `hds example display-settings`

## validatePreferences

Validate each preference against the allowed choices.

Kind: utility · Import: `@hyeonse/design-system/preferences`

```typescript
export declare function validatePreferences(value: unknown, defaults?: Partial<Preferences>): Preferences;
```

### Usage

- A valid stored field wins; missing or invalid fields use valid site defaults, then defaultPreferences.

### States

- system/light/dark
- cobalt/forest/coral
- comfortable/compact
- crisp/soft
- full/reduced

### Limits

- Non-object and array inputs are treated as empty preferences.

Examples: `hds example display-settings`

## parsePreferences

Parse and validate a stored JSON preference string.

Kind: utility · Import: `@hyeonse/design-system/preferences`

```typescript
export declare function parsePreferences(raw: string | null, defaults?: Partial<Preferences>): Preferences;
```

### Usage

- Malformed JSON and null fall back through validatePreferences with optional site defaults.

Examples: `hds example display-settings`

## serializePreferences

Serialize validated preferences to JSON.

Kind: utility · Import: `@hyeonse/design-system/preferences`

```typescript
export declare function serializePreferences(value: Preferences): string;
```

### Usage

- Invalid fields fall back to package defaults before serialization.

### Limits

- This function does not accept site-specific defaults.

Examples: `hds example display-settings`

## resolvedTheme

Resolve system/light/dark to the effective light or dark theme.

Kind: utility · Import: `@hyeonse/design-system/preferences`

```typescript
export declare function resolvedTheme(theme: ThemePreference, systemDark: boolean): 'light' | 'dark';
```

### Usage

- The system choice follows the supplied systemDark boolean.

### States

- light
- dark

Examples: `hds example display-settings`

## effectiveMotion

Resolve the motion choice with the device reduced-motion preference.

Kind: utility · Import: `@hyeonse/design-system/preferences`

```typescript
export declare function effectiveMotion(motion: MotionPreference, systemReduced: boolean): MotionPreference;
```

### Usage

- A true systemReduced value forces reduced even when the stored choice is full.

### States

- full
- reduced

### Accessibility

- Device reduced motion takes precedence.

Examples: `hds example display-settings`

## createPreferenceScript

Create the inline first-paint preference script with optional key and site defaults.

Kind: utility · Import: `@hyeonse/design-system/preferences`

```typescript
export declare function createPreferenceScript(storageKey?: string, defaults?: Partial<Preferences>): string;
```

### Usage

- Insert the result in the document head before CSS paints.
- Pass the same storageKey and defaults to PreferencesProvider.

### States

- Sets data-theme, data-theme-preference, data-accent, data-density, data-corners, and data-motion on the document root.

### Accessibility

- Applies the device reduced-motion preference.

### Limits

- The generated script reads storage and media preferences once; PreferencesProvider handles later changes.

Examples: `hds example display-settings`

## preferenceScript

Ready-made first-paint script using the package key and defaults.

Kind: utility · Import: `@hyeonse/design-system/preferences`

```typescript
export declare const preferenceScript: string;
```

### Usage

- Insert in the document head before CSS paints.

### Accessibility

- Applies the device reduced-motion preference.

### Limits

- Use createPreferenceScript for a different key or site defaults.

Examples: `hds example display-settings`

## PreferencesProvider

Provide display preferences and keep document attributes in sync.

Kind: provider · Import: `@hyeonse/design-system/react`

```typescript
export declare function PreferencesProvider({ children, storageKey, eventName, defaults }: {
    children: ReactNode;
    storageKey?: string;
    eventName?: string;
    defaults?: Partial<Preferences>;
}): import("react").JSX.Element;
```

### Locally declared props

- `children`: `ReactNode`
- `storageKey?`: `string`
- `eventName?`: `string`
- `defaults?`: `Partial<Preferences>`

### Usage

- Wrap consumers of usePreferences, ThemeToggle, and PreferencesPanel.
- The defaults prop supplies valid site defaults for missing or invalid stored fields and reset.

### States

- Reads storage on mount; listens for matching-key or cleared storage events and device color/motion changes.
- Updates this tab and dispatches the configured CustomEvent after applying document attributes.

### Accessibility

- The device reduced-motion preference overrides a full-motion choice.

### Limits

- Storage writes may fail; the current tab still updates.
- Server rendering starts with validated defaults before browser storage is read.

Examples: `hds example display-settings`

## usePreferences

Read preferences and the setPreference/resetPreferences actions from context.

Kind: hook · Import: `@hyeonse/design-system/react`

```typescript
export declare function usePreferences(): PreferenceContext;
```

### Usage

- Call inside PreferencesProvider.
- resetPreferences restores the validated site defaults.

### Limits

- Throws when used outside PreferencesProvider.

Examples: `hds example display-settings`

## ThemeToggle

Cycle theme preference through system, light, and dark.

Kind: component · Import: `@hyeonse/design-system/react`

```typescript
export declare function ThemeToggle({ locale }: {
    locale?: Locale;
}): import("react").JSX.Element;
```

### Locally declared props

- `locale?`: `Locale`

### Usage

- Render inside PreferencesProvider; locale defaults to ko and also accepts en.
- Import components.css for the provided visual styles.

### States

- system
- light
- dark

### Accessibility

- Native button with a changing accessible label describing current and next modes.

### Limits

- Only theme preference is changed; the effective theme still follows the device in system mode.

Examples: `hds example display-settings`

```typescript
    locale?: Locale;
```

- cobalt/forest/coral

- crisp/soft

Examples: `hds example display-settings`

## Button

Native button with primary, secondary, and ghost visual variants.

Kind: component · Import: `@hyeonse/design-system/primitives`

```typescript
export declare function Button({ variant, size, loading, loadingLabel, type, disabled, className, children, ref, 'aria-busy': ariaBusy, 'aria-label': ariaLabel, 'aria-labelledby': ariaLabelledBy, ...props }: ButtonProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
```

### Locally declared props

- `variant?`: `'primary' | 'secondary' | 'ghost'`
- `size?`: `HdsSize`
- `loading?`: `boolean`
- `loadingLabel?`: `string`

### Usage

- Import from @hyeonse/design-system/primitives and import components.css after tokens.css.
- Native button attributes and ref are forwarded; type defaults to button. The caller manages loading state.
- size accepts xs/sm/md/lg/xl; omitted size inherits the nearest SizeProvider or layout, falling back to md. A child size overrides its parent, including across portals.

### States

- primary/secondary/ghost variants
- xs/sm/md/lg/xl sizes; inherited md default
- enabled/disabled/loading

### Accessibility

- Native button keyboard behavior.
- Loading disables the button, sets aria-busy, and uses loadingLabel as visible and accessible text when supplied.

### Limits

- Loading does not start or track an asynchronous operation.
- Renders a button element, not a link.

Examples: `hds example form-controls`

## TextField

Labeled single-line input with optional hint and error text.

Kind: component · Import: `@hyeonse/design-system/primitives`

```typescript
export declare function TextField({ label, hint, error, size, inputSize, type, id, className, disabled, ref, 'aria-describedby': ariaDescribedBy, 'aria-invalid': ariaInvalid, ...props }: TextFieldProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
```

### Locally declared props

- `size?`: `HdsSize`
- `inputSize?`: `number`
- `label`: `string`
- `type?`: `TextInputType`
- `hint?`: `string`
- `error?`: `string`

### Usage

- Import from @hyeonse/design-system/primitives and import components.css after tokens.css.
- Native input attributes and ref are forwarded; className applies to the input element.
- size accepts xs/sm/md/lg/xl; omitted size inherits the nearest SizeProvider or layout, falling back to md. A child size overrides its parent, including across portals.

### States

- text/email/password/search/tel/url types
- enabled/disabled/readOnly
- hint/error

### Accessibility

- The label targets the supplied id or a generated id.
- Hint and error IDs are added to aria-describedby alongside a caller-supplied description; an error sets aria-invalid.

### Limits

- Single-line input only; the caller owns validation and error messages.

Examples: `hds example form-controls`

## Checkbox

Labeled native checkbox with optional hint and error text.

Kind: component · Import: `@hyeonse/design-system/primitives`

```typescript
export declare function Checkbox({ label, hint, error, size, inputSize, id, className, disabled, readOnly, ref, onClick, onChange, 'aria-describedby': ariaDescribedBy, 'aria-invalid': ariaInvalid, 'aria-readonly': ariaReadOnly, ...props }: CheckboxProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
```

### Locally declared props

- `size?`: `HdsSize`
- `inputSize?`: `number`
- `label`: `string`
- `hint?`: `string`
- `error?`: `string`

### Usage

- Import from @hyeonse/design-system/primitives and import components.css after tokens.css.
- Native checkbox attributes, checked/defaultChecked, and ref are forwarded; className applies to the input element.
- size accepts xs/sm/md/lg/xl; omitted size inherits the nearest SizeProvider or layout, falling back to md. A child size overrides its parent, including across portals.

### States

- checked/unchecked
- enabled/disabled/readOnly
- hint/error

### Accessibility

- The label targets the supplied id or a generated id.
- Hint and error IDs are added to aria-describedby alongside a caller-supplied description; an error sets aria-invalid.
- readOnly exposes aria-readonly and prevents click changes while retaining focus.

### Limits

- A checkbox has no native readOnly behavior; the component cancels clicks to preserve its value.
- The caller owns validation and error messages.

Examples: `hds example form-controls`

### States

### Accessibility

- Renders a span with its text content; tone alone does not announce meaning.

### Limits

Examples: `hds example form-controls`

- `size?`: `HdsSize`

### Usage

- Import from @hyeonse/design-system/fields; load tokens.css before components.css.

- controlled/uncontrolled

### Accessibility

### Limits

## Select

Labeled single-choice dropdown from fixed options.

Kind: component · Import: `@hyeonse/design-system/fields`

```typescript
export declare function Select({ label, hint, error, size, options, name, form, id, required, disabled, readOnly, value, defaultValue, onValueChange, placeholder, className, ref, 'aria-describedby': describedBy, 'aria-invalid': invalid }: SelectProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
```

### Locally declared props

- `label`: `string`
- `hint?`: `string`
- `error?`: `string`
- `size?`: `HdsSize`
- `options`: `readonly FieldOption[]`
- `name?`: `string`
- `form?`: `string`
- `id?`: `string`
- `required?`: `boolean`
- `disabled?`: `boolean`
- `readOnly?`: `boolean`
- `value?`: `string | null`
- `defaultValue?`: `string | null`
- `onValueChange?`: `(value: string | null) => void`
- `placeholder?`: `string`
- `className?`: `string`
- `aria-describedby?`: `string`
- `aria-invalid?`: `boolean | 'grammar' | 'spelling'`
- `ref?`: `Ref<HTMLButtonElement>`

### Usage

- Import from @hyeonse/design-system/fields; load tokens.css before components.css.
- The caller owns validation, error text, and controlled state.
- size accepts xs/sm/md/lg/xl; omitted size inherits the nearest SizeProvider or layout, falling back to md. A child size overrides its parent, including across portals.

### States

- empty/selected
- enabled/disabled/readOnly
- required
- hint/error

### Accessibility

- Base UI manages listbox keyboard navigation, option states, and form submission.
- Visible label names the trigger; hint and error describe it.

### Limits

- Options are not searchable; use Combobox for filtering.
- Option values must be unique strings.

Examples: `hds example expanded-forms`

### Usage

- Import from @hyeonse/design-system/fields; load tokens.css before components.css.
- The caller owns validation, error text, and controlled state.

- empty/selected
- enabled/disabled
- required
- hint/error
- controlled/uncontrolled

### Accessibility

- The native select uses the browser and screen reader picker without Base UI focus guards.
- Visible label, hint, and error are linked to the control.

### Limits

- Option values must be unique nonempty strings; empty string is reserved for the placeholder.
- Native select has no readOnly mode, and picker appearance follows the browser and operating system.

Examples: `hds example expanded-forms`

## Switch


### Locally declared props

- on/off
- enabled/disabled/readOnly
- required
- hint/error

### Accessibility

- Base UI provides switch semantics and keyboard interaction.
- Visible text and optional descriptions communicate state without color alone.

### Limits

- An unchecked switch submits no value unless uncheckedValue is supplied.

Examples: `hds example expanded-forms`

- The group is named by visible label and described by hint or error.

### Limits

- Option values must be unique strings.

Examples: `hds example expanded-forms`

## NativeDialog

Browser-native modal dialog with a title, optional description, body, footer, and close control.

Kind: component · Import: `@hyeonse/design-system/overlays`

```typescript
export declare function NativeDialog({ size, trigger, title, description, children, footer, closeLabel, open, defaultOpen, onOpenChange }: DialogProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
```

### Locally declared props

- `trigger`: `ReactElement`
- `title`: `string`
- `description?`: `string`
- `children?`: `ReactNode`
- `footer?`: `ReactNode`
- `closeLabel?`: `string`
- `open?`: `boolean`
- `defaultOpen?`: `boolean`
- `onOpenChange?`: `(open: boolean) => void`
- `size?`: `HdsSize`

### Usage

- Import from @hyeonse/design-system/overlays and load tokens.css then components.css.
- Pass a button trigger and a required title; use this native path when Base UI popup composition is unnecessary.
- With controlled open, a method="dialog" form requests onOpenChange(false). Keep open true to continue editing.
- size accepts xs/sm/md/lg/xl; omitted size inherits the nearest SizeProvider or layout, falling back to md. A child size overrides its parent, including across portals.

### States

- controlled or uncontrolled open
- optional description and footer
- xs/sm/md/lg/xl size

### Accessibility

- showModal supplies the native modal top layer; this wrapper keeps Tab and Shift+Tab inside without Base UI focus guards.
- Escape, close, outside dismissal, and trigger focus return are checked across browser engines.

### Limits

- Browser and screen-reader presentation can vary; actual VoiceOver speech still needs direct confirmation.
- The trigger must forward onClick and DOM ARIA props. Nested Base UI popup components can still render their own guards.

Examples: `hds example overlay-patterns`

## AlertDialog

Confirmation dialog that calls onConfirm only from its confirm button.

Kind: component · Import: `@hyeonse/design-system/overlays`

```typescript
export declare function AlertDialog({ size, trigger, title, description, children, confirmLabel, cancelLabel, onConfirm, onError, pending, confirmDisabled, open, defaultOpen, onOpenChange }: AlertDialogProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
```

### Locally declared props

- `trigger`: `ReactElement`
- `title`: `string`
- `description?`: `string`
- `children?`: `ReactNode`
- `confirmLabel`: `string`
- `cancelLabel`: `string`
- `onConfirm`: `() => void | Promise<void>`
- `onError?`: `(error: unknown) => void`
- `pending?`: `boolean`
- `confirmDisabled?`: `boolean`
- `open?`: `boolean`
- `defaultOpen?`: `boolean`
- `onOpenChange?`: `(open: boolean) => void`
- `size?`: `HdsSize`

### Usage

- Pass required title, confirmLabel, cancelLabel, and onConfirm.
- Use pending or confirmDisabled for externally controlled work; a rejected promise keeps the dialog open and is sent to onError.
- size accepts xs/sm/md/lg/xl; omitted size inherits the nearest SizeProvider or layout, falling back to md. A child size overrides its parent, including across portals.

### States

- controlled or uncontrolled open
- pending
- confirmDisabled
- confirming

### Accessibility

- Base UI supplies alert dialog focus and announcement semantics.
- Cancel and confirm are separate controls with at least 44px targets on coarse-pointer devices.

### Limits

- An externally controlled open prop must be updated by the caller after onOpenChange.
- The caller should present an error message when onConfirm rejects.

Examples: `hds example overlay-patterns`

## ToastProvider

Scoped, limited stack of transient announcements.

Kind: provider · Import: `@hyeonse/design-system/overlays`

```typescript
export declare function ToastProvider({ size, children, viewportLabel, closeLabel, timeout, limit }: ToastProviderProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
```

### Locally declared props

- `children`: `ReactNode`
- `viewportLabel?`: `string`
- `closeLabel?`: `string`
- `timeout?`: `number`
- `limit?`: `number`
- `size?`: `HdsSize`

### Usage

- Wrap useToast consumers once per independent region.
- Default viewport label is 알림 and close label is 알림 닫기; timeout defaults to 5000ms and visible limit to 3.
- size accepts xs/sm/md/lg/xl; omitted size inherits the nearest SizeProvider or layout, falling back to md. A child size overrides its parent, including across portals.

### States

- neutral/success/warning/danger tone
- auto expiry
- manual close
- limited queue

### Accessibility

- Base UI provides live announcements, F6 viewport focus, and pause behavior.
- Each toast has a close button with at least a 44px target on coarse-pointer devices.

### Limits

- The provider must mount in a client React tree.
- Only text title and description are exposed by this wrapper.

Examples: `hds example overlay-patterns`

## useToast

Add and close toasts within the nearest ToastProvider.

Kind: hook · Import: `@hyeonse/design-system/overlays`

```typescript
export declare function useToast(): {
    add: (message: ToastMessage) => string;
    close: (id: string) => void;
};
```

### Usage

- Call inside ToastProvider.
- add returns an ID to pass to close.

### States

- add
- close

### Accessibility

- Toast messages are announced by Base UI with priority low.

### Limits

- Throws outside a Base UI Toast provider.
- Do not use as the sole channel for critical persistent information.

Examples: `hds example overlay-patterns`

## SizeProvider

Provide one size to nested components, including React portals.

Kind: provider · Import: `@hyeonse/design-system/layout`

```typescript
export declare function SizeProvider({ size, children }: SizeProviderProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
```

### Locally declared props

- `size`: `Size`
- `children?`: `ReactNode`

### Usage

- Pass one required size: xs, sm, md, lg, or xl; adds no DOM element.
- Children inherit this size unless they supply an explicit size.

### States

- xs/sm/md/lg/xl

### Accessibility

- Touch controls retain at least 44px targets.

### Limits

- Layout adds no application landmarks or route behavior.

Examples: `hds example layout-sizing`

## Stack

Vertical layout with inherited size and optional gap override.

Kind: component · Import: `@hyeonse/design-system/layout`

```typescript
export declare function Stack({ size, gap, align, className, style, children, ...props }: StackProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
```

### Locally declared props

- `size?`: `Size`
- `gap?`: `Size`
- `align?`: `'start' | 'center' | 'end' | 'stretch'`

### Usage

- Use size for child components and gap for spacing only.
- Omitted size inherits the nearest provider or layout; default md. Explicit child size wins.

### States

- xs/sm/md/lg/xl

### Accessibility

- Touch controls retain at least 44px targets.

### Limits

- Layout adds no application landmarks or route behavior.

Examples: `hds example layout-sizing`

- Use wrap=false only when content is known to fit; wrapping is the default.

# Type context

## @hyeonse/design-system/preferences

```typescript
export type ThemePreference = 'system' | 'light' | 'dark';
export type AccentPreference = 'cobalt' | 'forest' | 'coral';
export type DensityPreference = 'comfortable' | 'compact';
export type CornersPreference = 'crisp' | 'soft';
export type MotionPreference = 'full' | 'reduced';
export type Preferences = {
    theme: ThemePreference;
    accent: AccentPreference;
    density: DensityPreference;
    corners: CornersPreference;
    motion: MotionPreference;
};
export declare const preferencesKey = "hyeonse-site-preferences";
export declare const defaultPreferences: Preferences;
export declare function validatePreferences(value: unknown, defaults?: Partial<Preferences>): Preferences;
export declare function parsePreferences(raw: string | null, defaults?: Partial<Preferences>): Preferences;
export declare function serializePreferences(value: Preferences): string;
export declare function resolvedTheme(theme: ThemePreference, systemDark: boolean): 'light' | 'dark';
export declare function effectiveMotion(motion: MotionPreference, systemReduced: boolean): MotionPreference;
export declare function createPreferenceScript(storageKey?: string, defaults?: Partial<Preferences>): string;
export declare const preferenceScript: string;
```

## @hyeonse/design-system/react

```typescript
import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
import type { Preferences } from './preferences.js';
export type Locale = 'ko' | 'en';
type PreferenceContext = {
    preferences: Preferences;
    setPreference: <K extends keyof Preferences>(key: K, value: Preferences[K]) => void;
    resetPreferences: () => void;
};
export declare function PreferencesProvider({ children, storageKey, eventName, defaults }: {
    children: ReactNode;
    storageKey?: string;
    eventName?: string;
    defaults?: Partial<Preferences>;
}): import("react").JSX.Element;
export declare function usePreferences(): PreferenceContext;
export declare function ThemeToggle({ locale }: {
    locale?: Locale;
}): import("react").JSX.Element;
export declare function PreferencesPanel({ locale }: {
    locale?: Locale;
}): import("react").JSX.Element;
export {};
```

## @hyeonse/design-system/primitives

```typescript
import type { HdsSize } from './sizing.js';
import type { ComponentPropsWithRef } from 'react';
export type ButtonProps = ComponentPropsWithRef<'button'> & {
    variant?: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'ghost';
    size?: HdsSize;
    loading?: boolean;
    loadingLabel?: string;
};
export declare function Button({ variant, size, loading, loadingLabel, type, disabled, className, children, ref, 'aria-busy': ariaBusy, 'aria-label': ariaLabel, 'aria-labelledby': ariaLabelledBy, ...props }: ButtonProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
type TextInputType = 'text' | 'email' | 'password' | 'search' | 'tel' | 'url';
export type TextFieldProps = Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<'input'>, 'type' | 'children' | 'size'> & {
    size?: HdsSize;
    inputSize?: number;
    label: string;
    type?: TextInputType;
    hint?: string;
    error?: string;
};
export declare function TextField({ label, hint, error, size, inputSize, type, id, className, disabled, ref, 'aria-describedby': ariaDescribedBy, 'aria-invalid': ariaInvalid, ...props }: TextFieldProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
export type CheckboxProps = Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<'input'>, 'type' | 'children' | 'size'> & {
    size?: HdsSize;
    inputSize?: number;
    label: string;
    hint?: string;
    error?: string;
};
export declare function Checkbox({ label, hint, error, size, inputSize, id, className, disabled, readOnly, ref, onClick, onChange, 'aria-describedby': ariaDescribedBy, 'aria-invalid': ariaInvalid, 'aria-readonly': ariaReadOnly, ...props }: CheckboxProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
export type BadgeProps = ComponentPropsWithRef<'span'> & {
    size?: HdsSize;
    tone?: 'neutral' | 'accent' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger';
};
export declare function Badge({ size, tone, className, children, ref, ...props }: BadgeProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
export {};
```

## @hyeonse/design-system/fields

```typescript
import type { ComponentPropsWithRef, Ref } from 'react';
import type { HdsSize } from './sizing.js';
type FieldText = {
    label: string;
    hint?: string;
    error?: string;
    size?: HdsSize;
};
type TextualType = 'text' | 'email' | 'search' | 'tel' | 'url';
export type InputProps = Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<'input'>, 'type' | 'children' | 'size'> & {
    type?: TextualType;
    size?: HdsSize;
    inputSize?: number;
};
export declare function Input({ type, size, inputSize, className, ref, ...props }: InputProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
export type TextareaProps = Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<'textarea'>, 'children'> & FieldText;
export declare function Textarea({ label, hint, error, size, id, className, disabled, ref, 'aria-describedby': describedBy, 'aria-invalid': invalid, ...props }: TextareaProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
export type FieldOption = {
    value: string;
    label: string;
    disabled?: boolean;
};
type ChoiceProps = FieldText & {
    options: readonly FieldOption[];
    name?: string;
    form?: string;
    id?: string;
    required?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
    readOnly?: boolean;
    value?: string | null;
    defaultValue?: string | null;
    onValueChange?: (value: string | null) => void;
    placeholder?: string;
    className?: string;
    'aria-describedby'?: string;
    'aria-invalid'?: boolean | 'grammar' | 'spelling';
};
export type SelectProps = ChoiceProps & {
    ref?: Ref<HTMLButtonElement>;
};
export declare function Select({ label, hint, error, size, options, name, form, id, required, disabled, readOnly, value, defaultValue, onValueChange, placeholder, className, ref, 'aria-describedby': describedBy, 'aria-invalid': invalid }: SelectProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
/** Native picker for fixed choices when browser and screen-reader controls are preferred. */
export type NativeSelectProps = Omit<ChoiceProps, 'readOnly'> & {
    ref?: Ref<HTMLSelectElement>;
};
export declare function NativeSelect({ label, hint, error, size, options, name, form, id, required, disabled, value, defaultValue, onValueChange, placeholder, className, ref, 'aria-describedby': describedBy, 'aria-invalid': invalid }: NativeSelectProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
export type ComboboxProps = ChoiceProps & {
    ref?: Ref<HTMLInputElement>;
    emptyText?: string;
    openLabel?: string;
    inputValue?: string;
    defaultInputValue?: string;
    onInputValueChange?: (value: string) => void;
};
export declare function Combobox({ label, hint, error, size, options, name, form, id, required, disabled, readOnly, value, defaultValue, onValueChange, placeholder, emptyText, openLabel, inputValue, defaultInputValue, onInputValueChange, className, ref, 'aria-describedby': describedBy, 'aria-invalid': invalid }: ComboboxProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
export type MultiSelectProps = Omit<ChoiceProps, 'value' | 'defaultValue' | 'onValueChange'> & {
    ref?: Ref<HTMLInputElement>;
    value?: readonly string[];
    defaultValue?: readonly string[];
    onValueChange?: (value: string[]) => void;
    emptyText?: string;
    openLabel?: string;
    selectedLabel?: string;
    removeLabel?: (label: string) => string;
    chipDescription?: string;
    inputDescription?: (count: number) => string;
    inputValue?: string;
    defaultInputValue?: string;
    onInputValueChange?: (value: string) => void;
};
export declare function MultiSelect({ label, hint, error, size, options, name, form, id, required, disabled, readOnly, value, defaultValue, onValueChange, placeholder, emptyText, openLabel, selectedLabel, removeLabel, chipDescription, inputDescription, inputValue, defaultInputValue, onInputValueChange, className, ref, 'aria-describedby': describedBy, 'aria-invalid': invalid }: MultiSelectProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
export type SwitchProps = FieldText & {
    id?: string;
    name?: string;
    form?: string;
    value?: string;
    uncheckedValue?: string;
    required?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
    readOnly?: boolean;
    checked?: boolean;
    defaultChecked?: boolean;
    onCheckedChange?: (checked: boolean) => void;
    ref?: Ref<HTMLInputElement>;
    className?: string;
    'aria-describedby'?: string;
    'aria-invalid'?: boolean | 'grammar' | 'spelling';
};
export declare function Switch({ label, hint, error, size, id, name, form, value, uncheckedValue, required, disabled, readOnly, checked, defaultChecked, onCheckedChange, ref, className, 'aria-describedby': describedBy, 'aria-invalid': invalid }: SwitchProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
export type RadioGroupProps = FieldText & {
    options: readonly FieldOption[];
    name?: string;
    form?: string;
    required?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
    readOnly?: boolean;
    value?: string;
    defaultValue?: string;
    onValueChange?: (value: string) => void;
    ref?: Ref<HTMLInputElement>;
    className?: string;
    'aria-describedby'?: string;
    'aria-invalid'?: boolean | 'grammar' | 'spelling';
};
export declare function RadioGroup({ label, hint, error, size, options, name, form, required, disabled, readOnly, value, defaultValue, onValueChange, ref, className, 'aria-describedby': describedBy, 'aria-invalid': invalid }: RadioGroupProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
export type SliderProps = Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<'input'>, 'type' | 'children' | 'size' | 'readOnly'> & FieldText & {
    inputSize?: number;
};
export declare function Slider({ label, hint, error, size, inputSize, id, disabled, className, ref, 'aria-describedby': describedBy, 'aria-invalid': invalid, ...props }: SliderProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
export type NumberFieldProps = FieldText & {
    id?: string;
    name?: string;
    form?: string;
    required?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
    readOnly?: boolean;
    value?: number | null;
    defaultValue?: number;
    onValueChange?: (value: number | null) => void;
    min?: number;
    max?: number;
    step?: number | 'any';
    locale?: Intl.LocalesArgument;
    placeholder?: string;
    incrementLabel?: string;
    decrementLabel?: string;
    ref?: Ref<HTMLInputElement>;
    className?: string;
    'aria-describedby'?: string;
    'aria-invalid'?: boolean | 'grammar' | 'spelling';
};
export declare function NumberField({ label, hint, error, size, id, name, form, required, disabled, readOnly, value, defaultValue, onValueChange, min, max, step, locale, placeholder, incrementLabel, decrementLabel, ref, className, 'aria-describedby': describedBy, 'aria-invalid': invalid }: NumberFieldProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
export type DateFieldProps = Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<'input'>, 'type' | 'children' | 'size'> & FieldText & {
    inputSize?: number;
};
export declare function DateField({ label, hint, error, size, inputSize, id, disabled, className, ref, 'aria-describedby': describedBy, 'aria-invalid': invalid, ...props }: DateFieldProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
export type FileInputProps = Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<'input'>, 'type' | 'children' | 'size' | 'value' | 'defaultValue' | 'readOnly'> & FieldText & {
    inputSize?: number;
};
export declare function FileInput({ label, hint, error, size, inputSize, id, disabled, className, ref, 'aria-describedby': describedBy, 'aria-invalid': invalid, ...props }: FileInputProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
export type PasswordFieldProps = Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<'input'>, 'type' | 'children' | 'size'> & FieldText & {
    inputSize?: number;
    showLabel?: string;
    hideLabel?: string;
};
export declare function PasswordField({ label, hint, error, size, inputSize, id, disabled, className, ref, showLabel, hideLabel, 'aria-describedby': describedBy, 'aria-invalid': invalid, ...props }: PasswordFieldProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
export {};
```

```typescript
import type { ReactElement, ReactNode } from 'react';

export type MenuEntry = {
    kind: 'action';
    id: string;

    disabled?: boolean;
    danger?: boolean;
} | {

    id: string;

    checked: boolean;
    onCheckedChange: (checked: boolean) => void;
    disabled?: boolean;
} | {
    kind: 'separator';
    id: string;

    id: string;
    label: string;
    items: readonly MenuEntry[];
    disabled?: boolean;
};

    trigger: ReactElement;

    trigger: ReactElement;
```

## @hyeonse/design-system/layout

```typescript
import type { ComponentPropsWithRef, ReactNode } from 'react';
import type { HdsSize } from './sizing.js';
/** Five consistent size steps. Omitted sizes inherit the nearest layout/provider. */
export type Size = HdsSize;
export type SizeProviderProps = {
    size: Size;
    children?: ReactNode;
};
/** Shares size through React portals without adding an element to the page. */
export declare function SizeProvider({ size, children }: SizeProviderProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
type LayoutProps = ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'> & {
    size?: Size;
};
export type StackProps = LayoutProps & {
    gap?: Size;
    align?: 'start' | 'center' | 'end' | 'stretch';
};
export declare function Stack({ size, gap, align, className, style, children, ...props }: StackProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
export type InlineProps = LayoutProps & {
    gap?: Size;
    align?: 'start' | 'center' | 'end' | 'stretch';
    justify?: 'start' | 'center' | 'end' | 'between';
    wrap?: boolean;
};
export declare function Inline({ size, gap, align, justify, wrap, className, children, ...props }: InlineProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
export type GridProps = LayoutProps & {
    gap?: Size;
    columns?: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4;
    minItemWidth?: string;
};
/** Columns collapse with available width; minItemWidth controls the preferred item width. */
export declare function Grid({ size, gap, columns, minItemWidth, style, className, children, ...props }: GridProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
export type ContainerProps = LayoutProps & {
    fluid?: boolean;
};
/** A centered, fluid container capped by its size with scaled horizontal padding. */
export declare function Container({ size, fluid, className, children, ...props }: ContainerProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
export {};
```

# CSS tokens

Values are CSS expressions, with their original selector and media-query conditions. This is the package catalog format, not a DTCG token interchange file.

## --ink

Primary foreground text

Default: `#101114`

- `:root[data-theme='dark']` → `#f2f4f8`
- @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) · `:root:not([data-theme])` → `#f2f4f8`

## --paper

Page background

Default: `#ffffff`

- `:root[data-theme='dark']` → `#111318`
- @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) · `:root:not([data-theme])` → `#111318`

## --muted

Secondary text

Default: `#5a606b`

- `:root[data-theme='dark']` → `#b2b8c4`
- @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) · `:root:not([data-theme])` → `#b2b8c4`

## --line

Subtle dividing line

Default: `#d8dbe3`

- `:root[data-theme='dark']` → `#444a56`
- @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) · `:root:not([data-theme])` → `#444a56`

## --surface

Grouped content surface

Default: `#f3f5f8`

- `:root[data-theme='dark']` → `#1c2028`
- @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) · `:root:not([data-theme])` → `#1c2028`

## --surface-raised

Raised content surface

Default: `#ffffff`

- `:root[data-theme='dark']` → `#282d37`
- @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) · `:root:not([data-theme])` → `#282d37`

## --accent-solid

Solid accent surface

Default: `#204cfc`

- `:root[data-accent='forest']` → `#087451`
- `:root[data-accent='coral']` → `#b93d20`

## --accent-text

Accent text, link, selection, and focus

Default: `#204cfc`

- `:root[data-accent='forest']` → `#087451`
- `:root[data-accent='coral']` → `#b93d20`
- `:root[data-theme='dark']` → `#9aafff`
- `:root[data-theme='dark'][data-accent='forest']` → `#68dfb1`
- `:root[data-theme='dark'][data-accent='coral']` → `#ffa58e`
- @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) · `:root:not([data-theme])` → `#9aafff`
- @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) · `:root:not([data-theme])[data-accent='forest']` → `#68dfb1`
- @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) · `:root:not([data-theme])[data-accent='coral']` → `#ffa58e`

## --palette-cobalt

Cobalt palette reference

Default: `#204cfc`

Forest palette reference

Default: `#087451`

## --palette-coral

Coral palette reference

Default: `#b93d20`

Default: `#ffffff`

Default: `#b42332`

- `:root[data-theme='dark']` → `#ff9ba5`
- @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) · `:root:not([data-theme])` → `#ff9ba5`

## --danger-surface

Danger or validation-error background

Default: `#fff1f2`

- `:root[data-theme='dark']` → `#351f25`
- @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) · `:root:not([data-theme])` → `#351f25`

## --danger-line

Danger or validation-error border

Default: `#c64a59`

- `:root[data-theme='dark']` → `#c26b77`
- @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) · `:root:not([data-theme])` → `#c26b77`

## --space-1

Spacing step 1 (4px); pair with --space-factor for density-aware spacing

Default: `4px`

## --space-2

Spacing step 2 (8px); pair with --space-factor for density-aware spacing

Default: `8px`

## --space-3

Spacing step 3 (12px); pair with --space-factor for density-aware spacing

Default: `12px`

## --space-4

Spacing step 4 (16px); pair with --space-factor for density-aware spacing

Default: `16px`

## --space-5

Spacing step 5 (24px); pair with --space-factor for density-aware spacing

Default: `24px`

## --space-6

Spacing step 6 (32px); pair with --space-factor for density-aware spacing

Default: `32px`

## --space-7

Spacing step 7 (48px); pair with --space-factor for density-aware spacing

Default: `48px`

## --space-8

Spacing step 8 (64px); pair with --space-factor for density-aware spacing

Default: `64px`

## --text-xs

Extra-small text size

Default: `12px`

## --text-sm

Small text size

Default: `14px`

## --text-base

Base text size

Default: `16px`

## --text-lg

Large text size

Default: `20px`

## --leading-body

Body text line-height

Default: `1.6`

## --duration-fast

Fast interaction transition duration

Default: `140ms`

## --overlay-scrim

Background scrim behind modal overlays

Default: `rgba(0, 0, 0, .48)`

## --shadow-popover

Elevation shadow for menus, select popups, and popovers

Default: `0 8px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, .16)`

## --shadow-dialog

Elevation shadow for modal dialogs and sheets

Default: `0 24px 72px rgba(0, 0, 0, .24)`

# Examples

## layout-sizing

Five size steps, inherited component sizing and responsive layout primitives.

### examples/layout-sizing.tsx

```tsx
import { Container, Grid, Inline, Stack, SizeProvider } from '@hyeonse/design-system/layout';
import { Button, TextField } from '@hyeonse/design-system/primitives';
import { Card } from '@hyeonse/design-system/display';

export function LayoutSizingExample() {
  return <SizeProvider size="sm"><Container size="lg"><Stack gap="xl">
    <Grid columns={2} size="sm"><Card title="기본 정보"><TextField label="프로젝트 이름" inputSize={24} /></Card><Card title="공유 설정">공개 범위를 정해요.</Card></Grid>
    <Inline size="sm" justify="end"><Button variant="secondary">취소</Button><Button size="md">저장</Button></Inline>
  </Stack></Container></SizeProvider>;
}
```

## display-settings

React display settings with first-paint preferences and public imports.

### examples/preferences.ts

```typescript
import { createPreferenceScript } from '@hyeonse/design-system/preferences';
import type { Preferences } from '@hyeonse/design-system/preferences';

// Share these values between the document head and the client Provider.
export const storageKey = 'example-display-preferences';
export const siteDefaults = { corners: 'soft' } satisfies Partial<Preferences>;
export const initialPreferenceScript = createPreferenceScript(storageKey, siteDefaults);

// Insert initialPreferenceScript in a <script> in the document head before CSS.
// Use your framework's script/HTML API; do not concatenate user input into HTML.
```

### examples/display-settings.tsx

```tsx
'use client';

import { PreferencesPanel, PreferencesProvider, ThemeToggle, usePreferences } from '@hyeonse/design-system/react';
import '@hyeonse/design-system/tokens.css';
import '@hyeonse/design-system/components.css';
import { siteDefaults, storageKey } from './preferences.js';

function ReadingPreference() {
  const { preferences, setPreference } = usePreferences();
  return <label>
    <input type="checkbox" checked={preferences.motion === 'reduced'}
      onChange={event => setPreference('motion', event.target.checked ? 'reduced' : 'full')} />
    움직임 줄이기
  </label>;
}

export function DisplaySettings() {
  return <PreferencesProvider storageKey={storageKey} defaults={siteDefaults}>
    <ThemeToggle locale="ko" />
    <PreferencesPanel locale="ko" />
    <ReadingPreference />
  </PreferencesProvider>;
}
```

## token-card

HTML card preview for this repository or an unpacked package; consuming apps import @hyeonse/design-system/tokens.css instead of the preview-only ../dist link.

### examples/token-card.css

```css
/* App-owned markup/styles: the package does not export a Card component. */
.example-card {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  max-width: 42rem;
  padding: calc(24px * var(--space-factor));
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-card);
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  line-height: 1.7;
}
.example-card h2 { margin: 0 0 .5em; }
.example-card p { color: var(--muted); }
.example-card a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: var(--control-min-size); color: var(--accent-text); text-underline-offset: .2em; }
.example-card a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent-text); outline-offset: 3px; }
```

### examples/token-card.html

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="ko">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
    <title>역할 토큰으로 만든 카드</title>
    <!-- Preview at /examples/token-card.html after building this repository, or from an unpacked package with dist/ beside examples/. -->
    <!-- The ../dist link is for this standalone preview only. In a consuming app, copy the markup/CSS and import @hyeonse/design-system/tokens.css through its public package path; do not copy this relative link. -->
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../dist/tokens.css">
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="./token-card.css">
  </head>
  <body>
    <main>
      <article class="example-card" aria-labelledby="card-title">
        <h2 id="card-title">읽기 편한 화면 만들기</h2>
        <p>본문, 보조 글자, 링크에 서로 다른 역할 토큰을 사용합니다.</p>
        <a href="../docs/foundations.md">기초 규칙 읽기</a>
      </article>
    </main>
  </body>
</html>
```

## form-controls

React Button, TextField, Checkbox, and Badge with public imports and native attributes.

### examples/form-controls.tsx

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Badge, Button, Checkbox, TextField } from '@hyeonse/design-system/primitives';
import '@hyeonse/design-system/tokens.css';
import '@hyeonse/design-system/components.css';

type FormValues = { email: string; updates: boolean };

export function FormControls({ onSubmit, saving = false, emailError }: {
  onSubmit: (values: FormValues) => void;
  saving?: boolean;
  emailError?: string;
}) {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [updates, setUpdates] = useState(false);

  return <form onSubmit={event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    onSubmit({ email, updates });
  }}>
    <TextField
      label="이메일"
      name="email"
      type="email"
      autoComplete="email"
      required
      hint="연락받을 주소를 입력해 주세요."
      error={emailError}
      value={email}
      onChange={event => setEmail(event.currentTarget.value)}
    />
    <Checkbox
      label="업데이트 소식 받기"
      name="updates"
      checked={updates}
      onChange={event => setUpdates(event.currentTarget.checked)}
    />
    <Button type="submit" loading={saving} loadingLabel="저장 중">저장</Button>
    <Badge tone={emailError ? 'danger' : 'neutral'}>{emailError ? '이메일 확인 필요' : '입력 중'}</Badge>
  </form>;
}
```

## expanded-forms

Text, selection, search, number, date, and file controls with public imports.

### examples/expanded-forms.tsx

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Input, Textarea, Select, NativeSelect, Combobox, MultiSelect, Switch, RadioGroup, Slider, NumberField, DateField, FileInput, PasswordField } from '@hyeonse/design-system/fields';
import '@hyeonse/design-system/tokens.css';
import '@hyeonse/design-system/components.css';

const languages = [
  { value: 'ko', label: '한국어' },
  { value: 'en', label: 'English' },
  { value: 'ja', label: '日本語' },
];

export function ExpandedForms({ onSubmit }: { onSubmit: (data: FormData) => void }) {
  const [country, setCountry] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [skills, setSkills] = useState<string[]>(['ko']);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState<string | null>(null);

  return <form onSubmit={event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    onSubmit(new FormData(event.currentTarget));
  }}>
    <label htmlFor="expanded-alias">표시 이름</label>
    <Input id="expanded-alias" name="alias" required autoComplete="nickname" />
    <Textarea label="소개" name="bio" rows={3} hint="간단한 설명을 입력하세요." />
    <Select label="거주 국가" name="country" options={languages} placeholder="국가 선택" value={country} onValueChange={setCountry} required />
    <NativeSelect label="기본 국가 선택" name="nativeCountry" options={languages} placeholder="국가 선택" />
    <Combobox label="기본 언어" name="primaryLanguage" options={languages} value={search} onValueChange={setSearch} />
    <MultiSelect label="사용 언어" name="languages" options={languages} value={skills} onValueChange={setSkills} />
    <Switch label="알림 허용" name="notifications" defaultChecked hint="언제든 바꿀 수 있습니다." />
    <RadioGroup label="접근 수준" name="access" options={[{ value: 'viewer', label: '읽기' }, { value: 'editor', label: '편집' }]} defaultValue="viewer" />
    <Slider label="알림 빈도" name="frequency" min={0} max={10} defaultValue={5} />
    <NumberField label="초대 인원" name="seats" min={1} max={20} defaultValue={2} />
    <DateField label="시작 날짜" name="startDate" />
    <FileInput label="첨부 파일" name="attachment" accept=".pdf,.png" />
    <PasswordField label="접속 비밀번호" name="password" minLength={8} autoComplete="new-password" />
    <button type="submit">입력 확인</button>
  </form>;
}
```

## overlay-patterns

Menus, dialogs, sheets, popovers, tooltips, and scoped toast notifications.

### examples/overlay-patterns.tsx

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@hyeonse/design-system/primitives';
import { AlertDialog, ContextMenu, Dialog, NativeDialog, DropdownMenu, Popover, Sheet, ToastProvider, Tooltip, useToast } from '@hyeonse/design-system/overlays';
import { NativeSelect } from '@hyeonse/design-system/fields';
import type { MenuEntry } from '@hyeonse/design-system/overlays';
import '@hyeonse/design-system/tokens.css';
import '@hyeonse/design-system/components.css';

function OverlayControls() {
  const [pinned, setPinned] = useState(false);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('');
  const toast = useToast();
  const items: MenuEntry[] = [
    { kind: 'action', id: 'copy', label: '복사', onSelect: () => setStatus('복사했어요.') },
    { kind: 'checkbox', id: 'pin', label: '상단에 고정', checked: pinned, onCheckedChange: setPinned },
    { kind: 'submenu', id: 'move', label: '이동', items: [
      { kind: 'action', id: 'archive', label: '보관함', onSelect: () => setStatus('보관함으로 이동했어요.') },
    ] },
    { kind: 'separator', id: 'divider' },
    { kind: 'action', id: 'remove', label: '삭제', danger: true, onSelect: () => setStatus('삭제를 선택했어요.') },
  ];

  return <div>
    <DropdownMenu trigger={<Button type="button" variant="secondary">작업 메뉴</Button>} items={items} />
    <ContextMenu trigger={<button type="button">우클릭 메뉴 영역</button>} items={items} />
    <Dialog trigger={<Button type="button" variant="secondary">대화상자 열기</Button>} title="프로젝트 설정" description="변경할 항목을 확인하세요." footer={<Button type="button" onClick={() => setStatus('저장했어요.')}>저장</Button>}>
      설정 내용
    </Dialog>
    <NativeDialog trigger={<Button type="button" variant="secondary">네이티브 대화상자 열기</Button>} title="기본 설정" description="고정된 항목을 선택하세요.">
      <NativeSelect label="공개 범위" name="nativeVisibility" options={[{ value: 'private', label: '비공개' }, { value: 'public', label: '공개' }]} defaultValue="private" />
    </NativeDialog>
    <AlertDialog trigger={<Button type="button" variant="secondary">삭제 확인</Button>}
      title="프로젝트를 삭제할까요?" description="삭제 후에는 되돌릴 수 없습니다."
      confirmLabel="삭제" cancelLabel="취소" onConfirm={() => setStatus('삭제했어요.')} />
    <Sheet trigger={<Button type="button" variant="secondary">상세 패널</Button>} title="프로젝트 상세" side="right" size="md">
      상세 내용을 여기에 표시합니다.
    </Sheet>
    <Popover trigger={<Button type="button" variant="secondary">도움말 보기</Button>} title="도움말" description="최근 작업 내용을 확인하세요.">
      필요한 정보를 여기에 표시합니다.
    </Popover>
    <Tooltip trigger={<Button type="button" variant="ghost" aria-label="단축키 도움말">단축키</Button>} content="단축키 도움말" />
    <Button type="button" onClick={() => toast.add({ title: '저장 완료', description: '변경 사항을 저장했어요.', tone: 'success' })}>알림 보기</Button>
    <p role="status">{status}</p>
  </div>;
}

export function OverlayPatterns() {
  return <ToastProvider><OverlayControls /></ToastProvider>;
}
```

## display-patterns

Navigation, semantic tables, cards, progress, and feedback patterns.

### examples/display-patterns.tsx

```tsx
import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTab, TabsPanel, Accordion, AccordionItem, AccordionHeader, AccordionTrigger, AccordionPanel, Breadcrumb, Card, Alert, Progress } from '@hyeonse/design-system/display';

export function DisplayPatterns() {
  return <>
    <Breadcrumb items={[{ label: '홈', href: '/' }, { label: '설정' }]} />
    <Tabs defaultValue="overview"><TabsList activateOnFocus><TabsTab value="overview">개요</TabsTab><TabsTab value="details">상세</TabsTab></TabsList><TabsPanel value="overview">개요 내용</TabsPanel><TabsPanel value="details">상세 내용</TabsPanel></Tabs>
    <Accordion defaultValue={['shipping']}><AccordionItem value="shipping"><AccordionHeader><AccordionTrigger>배송 안내</AccordionTrigger></AccordionHeader><AccordionPanel>평균 2일이 걸립니다.</AccordionPanel></AccordionItem></Accordion>
    <Card title="주문 상태" description="오늘의 주문" footer="최종 갱신: 오늘"><Progress value={45} label="주문 진행률" /></Card>
    <Alert tone="success" title="저장 완료">변경사항을 저장했습니다.</Alert>
  </>;
}
```
